images.title: Sierpinski Triangle at Step 3
images.purpose: Show the count of what remains at Step 3: 27 triangles, 13 holes, area 27/64.
images.composition: One large Step 3 Sierpinski Triangle centred on white with three short count labels to its right.
images.exact_structure: One large equilateral triangle, point up, about 70 percent of the frame height, slightly left of centre, each side divided into 8 equal units. Exactly 27 small point-up equilateral triangles of side 1 unit are filled teal #0072B2 with thin dark outlines. All holes are white point-down triangles with thin grey #6B7280 outlines: 1 large central hole of side 4 units, 3 medium holes of side 2 units (one in the centre of each corner half-size triangle), and 9 small holes of side 1 unit, so 1 + 3 + 9 = 13 holes. Above the triangle, 'Step 3'. To the right, stacked with wide spacing: '27 triangles', '13 holes', 'area 27/64'.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Triangles multiply by 3, holes add up, and the area shrinks to 27/64.
images.description: Show the count of what remains at Step 3: 27 triangles, 13 holes, area 27/64.
images.context: One clean concept image for T3.C2.

image_decisions.why: The counts come straight from the picture; one clear Step 3 figure lets the child count and check.
